invariants.must_contain: The click is the edit, and undo is the safety net
invariants.why: the premise of a local editor stated where a handler is actually written: there is no server to ask, so the gesture itself is the mutation

invariants.must_contain: An input handler must not mutate the document
invariants.why: the only thing protecting the user is the history, so a handler emits a command instead of writing into the map

invariants.must_contain: One gesture is one undoable command
invariants.why: undo granularity is decided in the input layer and cannot be fixed downstream
